author: Sooner State News
title: Oklahoma and Texas agencies announce toll road interoperability agreement
text:
Oklahoma and Texas agencies announce toll road interoperability agreement
The North Texas Tollway Authority passed a resolution at its monthly Board meeting allowing the agency and the Oklahoma Turnpike Authority to become interoperable on their respective toll roads, according to a July 15 announcement. The Oklahoma Turnpike Authority is expected to pass a similar resolution at its Board meeting scheduled for October 31.
The resolutions begin work that will enable customers of the Oklahoma Turnpike Authority to use their Pikepass on toll roads in and around the Dallas-Fort Worth area. In turn, North Texas Tollway Authority customers will be able to use their TollTag on all ten turnpikes throughout Oklahoma. Implementation is anticipated by Fall 2014, after which customers could start using their tags across both states’ systems.
Oklahoma Governor Mary Fallin said, “This will be a tremendous convenience for motorists who travel between the two states and routinely take toll roads, both here in Oklahoma and in the Dallas area.” Fallin also said, “I encourage the Turnpike Authority Board to approve the item authorizing this agreement at their next scheduled meeting.”
Fallin added, “We’ve been pushing for interoperability for quite some time and I’m excited the two states could come together and get all the details worked out.”
Tim Stewart, Executive Director of the Oklahoma Turnpike Authority, said, “We hope to have everything in place so that Pikepass customers will be able to use their tag in the Dallas area by next fall. We continually listen to our customers, and being able to use their Pikepass in other states is just another added benefit they have requested and we are excited to be able to offer.”
The North Texas Tollway Authority operates three toll roads throughout the Dallas Metroplex: Dallas North Tollway, George Bush Turnpike, and Sam Rayburn Tollway. The agency also operates two toll bridges and a small toll tunnel.
